pipelines.name: Sync checkpoint tags

steps.name: Sync main onto checkpoint tags
steps.run:
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
./scripts/sync-checkpoints.sh --verify --push 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/sync.log"

steps.name: Summary
steps.run:
{
  echo "## Checkpoint sync"
  echo
  echo '```'
  cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/sync.log" 2>/dev/null || echo "No sync log."
  echo '```'
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

findings: [LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'sync' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
